result.title: scratch probe: secrets/env in a job-level if (#378, do not merge)
result.body:
Scratch probe for #378. Never merged, never armed; closed unmerged as the permanent record.

Five separate workflow files so one file's startup failure cannot mask another:

| file | form |
| --- | --- |
| `secr-a.yml` | job-level `if: ${{ secrets.WILLFIRE_SECR_A != '' }}`, plus an unguarded sibling job |
| `secr-b.yml` | job-level bare `if: secrets.WILLFIRE_SECR_B != ''`, plus an unguarded sibling job |
| `secr-c.yml` | step-level `if: ${{ secrets.WILLFIRE_SECR_C != '' }}` inside a valid job |
| `secr-d.yml` | job-level `if: ${{ env.SECR_D != '' }}`, plus an unguarded sibling job |
| `secr-ok.yml` | valid control, proves the failure is scoped to one file |

Measuring: which files produce a `pull_request` run at all, each run's conclusion, and which job names reach the check list.

commit.message:
Capture P9: the labeled activity type is outside the default types (#398)

Applying a label to scratch PR #379 dispatched only d-labeled.yml
(`types: [labeled]`) -- run 36430659796 at head 16dc992. Nothing on default
`types:` re-ran, `pull_request_target` included. Measured on both sides, so
`labeled` is settled; the other eighteen non-default activity types are not.

Green as recorded.

Refs #365

Applying a label to scratch PR #379 dispatched only d-labeled.yml
(`types: [labeled]`) -- run 36430659796 at head 16dc992. Nothing on default

Refs #365

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,14 @@
+P9: the `labeled` activity type, the decline side of `DEFAULT_TYPES`.
+
+Applying a label to scratch PR #379 dispatched `d-labeled.yml`
+(`types: [labeled]`) and nothing else — run 36430659796 at head `16dc992`,
+created 13:43:38Z, three minutes after the `opened` batch at 13:40:51Z.
+`d-default.yml` (bare `on: pull_request:`) did not re-run, nor did
+`pr-monitor.yml`, nor `prt-noop.yml` on `pull_request_target`. So `labeled` is
+outside the default type set, measured on both sides: it fires a workflow that
+names it and fires nothing that does not (#365).
+
+This settles `labeled` alone. The other eighteen non-default activity types
+remain a docs read.
+
+D15 is the `opened` dispatch at the same SHA.

@@ -0,0 +1,3 @@
+Scratch PR #379, closed unmerged. Two dispatches at head SHA `16dc992`: the
+`opened` that came with the PR, and a `labeled` from applying a label
+afterwards. One fixture per dispatch — D15 is the `opened`, P9 the `labeled`.

name: putitoutthere check

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'putitoutthere.toml'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'scripts/*/package.json'
      - '.github/workflows/release.yml'
      - '.github/workflows/check.yml'

jobs:
  putitoutthere-check:
    uses: thekevinscott/putitoutthere/.github/workflows/check.yml@v0

name: Testing Conventions (willfire)

# Runs the upstream testing-conventions gates over the root `willfire` package,
# pinned to the rolling `v0` tag (the same convention as check.yml).
#
# `gates` allowlists every gate except `unit-coverage`, which carries both the
# whole-tree and the changed-lines coverage jobs: willfire has no coverage
# requirement. Mutation's Stryker deps are in devDependencies, and
# `e2e-attestations/` holds the receipt the e2e-verify gate checks.
#
# One workflow file per workspace package (docs/monorepo.md), because `paths:`
# is per-file and each package's lane has a different trigger set.

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'e2e-attestations/**'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
      - 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'
      - 'tsconfig.json'
      - 'tsconfig.build.json'
      - 'vitest.config.mts'
      - '.github/workflows/conventions-src.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'e2e-attestations/**'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
      - 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'
      - 'tsconfig.json'
      - 'tsconfig.build.json'
      - 'vitest.config.mts'
      - '.github/workflows/conventions-src.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  # Job id kept as-is: it prefixes every check name this call produces.
  conventions:
    uses: thekevinscott/testing-conventions/.github/workflows/testing-conventions.yml@v0
    with:
      languages: '["typescript"]'
      source: src
      gates: >-
        ["colocated-test", "one-function-per-file", "unit-lint",
        "integration-lint", "mutation", "packaging", "e2e-verify", "changelog"]

name: integration

# The suite builds `src` and replays `tests/integration`, importing
# `tests/cases.ts` and `tests/getResponse.ts`; `attestations.test.ts` reads
# `e2e-attestations/`. `tests/e2e` and `tests/fixtures` are read by no CI job.
on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'tests/integration/**'
      - 'tests/cases.ts'
      - 'tests/getResponse.ts'
      - 'e2e-attestations/**'
      - 'tsconfig.json'
      - 'tsconfig.build.json'
      - 'vitest.config.mts'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
      - 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'
      - '.github/workflows/integration.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  integration:
    name: integration
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm test:integration

name: lint

on:
  pull_request:
    # eslint.config.js only matches src/**/*.ts and scripts/*/src/**/*.ts.
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'scripts/*/src/**'
      - 'eslint.config.js'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
      - '.github/workflows/lint.yml'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  lint:
    name: lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm lint

name: PR Monitor

on:
  pull_request:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  actions: read
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  monitor:
    name: 'CI Gate'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # The action has no timeout of its own (see monitor.ts) — this is the
    # backstop. If a predicted run never dispatches, the gate waits here
    # until the job is killed.
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: thekevinscott/pr-monitor@v1

name: prt-noop

# Permanent probe for case D13 (#328): pull_request_target is read from the
# default branch, so the only way a prediction of it can be exercised is a
# workflow that lives here forever.
on:
  pull_request_target:

permissions: {}

jobs:
  prt-noop:
    name: prt-noop
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 2
    steps:
      - run: 'true'

name: Release

# putitoutthere's reusable workflow; config lives in `putitoutthere.toml`
# at the repo root.
#
# Auth: the `NPM_TOKEN` secret is the first-publish bootstrap only —
# Trusted Publishing on npm binds to an already-published package, so
# the very first publish has no OIDC path. `willfire` is published:
# register the trusted publisher (repo thekevinscott/willfire,
# workflow release.yml, environment release), then DELETE the NPM_TOKEN
# secret; the OIDC exchange takes over.
#
# Filename matters: npm's trust policy matches the caller workflow
# filename. Renaming this file requires re-registering the trusted
# publisher.

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      release_packages:
        description: >
          Packages to release manually, bypassing change detection.
          Comma-separated list of name[@<bump|version>] entries, e.g.
          "willfire@minor" or "willfire@1.2.0". Leave empty to fall back
          to automatic change detection (same as a push).
        required: false
        default: ''

jobs:
  release:
    uses: thekevinscott/putitoutthere/.github/workflows/release.yml@v0
    with:
      release_packages: ${{ inputs.release_packages || '' }}
    secrets:
      NPM_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
    permissions:
      contents: write
      # Required even for the token-auth bootstrap publish: the
      # reusable workflow's publish job declares id-token: write, and
      # a caller granting less is a startup error.
      id-token: write

  # PyPI upload runs in the caller's workflow context (see
  # pypi/warehouse#11096). The `if:` gate skips this job for non-PyPI
  # repos — pasted verbatim per putitoutthere's README regardless of
  # what the repo publishes.
  pypi-publish:
    needs: release
    if: needs.release.outputs.has_pypi == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: release
    permissions:
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          pattern: '*-sdist'
          path: dist/
          merge-multiple: true
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          pattern: '*-wheel-*'
          path: dist/
          merge-multiple: true
      - uses: pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish@release/v1
